purpose: C04 classical baselines on synthetic data; offline evaluation only

windows._unit: days from generator epoch 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z, by decision time, [start, end)

train.rule: label_available_at <= cutoff; unknown labels are excluded, never relabeled legitimate

test.rule: is_fraud for every test row (offline benchmark; includes never-disclosed fraud); labels observable by the horizon end are reported separately

timeline.note: Train labels mature 30 days after the train window (legitimate maturity is 30 days). The model is fitted at day 85 and scores validation rows retrospectively with decision-time features; selection happens at day 115 on validation labels known by then; test decisions start after selection. Embargo gaps (day 55-56, 85-116) are chronological gaps only: 30-day feature windows still share earlier history (declared stream context, not independence).

selection.metric: average_precision on eligible validation rows (sklearn average_precision_score)
selection.tie_break: earlier entry in the candidate list wins exact ties

review_policy.capacity_unit: transactions per UTC calendar day of decision time
review_policy.ranking: score descending; ties by external_id ascending
review_policy.streaming_threshold: the score at rank k_per_day x (number of validation decision days), frozen from validation and applied unchanged to test (rows with score >= threshold are flagged)

calibration: no calibration step; scores are reported as uncalibrated model scores (Brier and reliability shown for information); rule scores are heuristics, never probabilities
test_access: test labels are read only by `python -m ml test`, once, after the selection record is frozen; a rerun must use --reproduce, which recomputes and compares without rewriting
